title: The sync control's reconnect and the picker's move are guarded separately
evidence: The picker's move is one page-life union (widget-src/standalone/switch-flow.ts, US-09 AC45). The sync control's Google Drive reconnect keeps its own claim, the module flag reconnectInFlight (widget-src/standalone/sync-control.tsx:84), with its busy state from useBusyRun (widget-src/standalone/connect.ts). The two do not see each other. Raised as Q6 in the A9 design; the owner left it out of AC45 (2026-11-12).
